items.title: Check Point warns of zero-day flaw exploited for root access
items.summary: Check Point Software has released emergency hotfixes to address a high-severity flaw that hackers have been exploiting to gain root privileges and establish persistence on vulnerable devices since late October. [...]
items.title_zh: Check Point 警告零日漏洞已被利用於取得 Root 權限
items.summary_zh: Check Point Software 已發布緊急修補程式（hotfixes），以解決自 10 月底以來駭客一直利用來取得 root 權限並在受影響裝置上建立持續性控制的高風險漏洞。[...]

items.title: Nightmare Eclipse Drops Windows Zero-Day Exploit ‘SignDrop’
items.summary: It abuses CLFS and Windows Defender to trigger arbitrary file creation in the context of the antimalware process. The post Nightmare Eclipse Drops Windows Zero-Day Exploit ‘SignDrop’ appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Nightmare Eclipse 釋出 Windows 零日漏洞利用程式「SignDrop」
items.summary_zh: 該漏洞利用濫用 CLFS 與 Windows Defender，在反惡意程式碼程序的情境下觸發任意檔案建立。這篇文章《Nightmare Eclipse Drops Windows Zero-Day Exploit ‘SignDrop’》首次出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: New N-able "4EverAble2Shell" zero-day exploited hours after PoC released
items.summary: Hackers are actively exploiting a newly disclosed N-able N-central zero-day vulnerability dubbed "4EverAble2Shell" to compromise servers and deploy cryptocurrency miners, with researchers reporting at least 21 affected systems, including 19 running the company's latest security update. [...]
items.title_zh: 全新 N-able「4EverAble2Shell」零日漏洞在 PoC 公布數小時內即遭利用
items.summary_zh: 駭客正主動利用新揭露、代號為「4EverAble2Shell」的 N-able N-central 零日漏洞來入侵伺服器並部署加密貨幣挖礦程式，研究人員報告至少有 21 個系統受影響，其中包括 19 個正在執行該公司最新安全更新的系統。[...]

items.title: Citrix Patches 10 Critical NetScaler Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Successful exploitation could lead to unexpected behavior or denial-of-service (DoS) conditions. The post Citrix Patches 10 Critical NetScaler Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Citrix 修補 10 個 NetScaler 重大漏洞
items.summary_zh: 成功利用這些漏洞可能會導致非預期行為或阻斷服務 (DoS) 情況。文章《Citrix Patches 10 Critical NetScaler Vulnerabilities》首次出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.summary: A critical vulnerability in the HTTP/2 module of Apache HTTP Server could be exploited by an unauthenticated attacker to obtain remote code execution (RCE). [...]

items.title: In Other News: New CISA Director Nominee, Connected Car Hacking, Baker Tilly Data Breach
items.summary: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Siemens details security advisory policy, OpenAI Codex backdoor risk, Microsoft warns of model weight backdoors. The post In Other News: New CISA Director Nominee, Connected Car Hacking, Baker Tilly Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 其他新聞：新任 CISA 局長提名人、聯網汽車駭客攻擊、Baker Tilly 資料外洩
items.summary_zh: 可能被忽略的值得關注新聞：Siemens 說明資安公告政策、OpenAI Codex 後門風險、微軟警告模型權重後門。這篇報導《其他新聞：新任 CISA 局長提名人、聯網汽車駭客攻擊、Baker Tilly 資料外洩》最早發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: PHP2Shell Exploited in Destructive Check Point Gateway Attacks
items.summary: PHP2Shell enabled initial compromise, while CVE-2026-123039 allowed attackers to elevate privileges to root. The post PHP2Shell Exploited in Destructive Check Point Gateway Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: PHP2Shell 在毀滅性 Check Point Gateway 攻擊中遭利用
items.summary_zh: PHP2Shell 實現了初始入侵，而 CVE-2026-123039 則允許攻擊者將權限提升至 root。這篇報導《PHP2Shell 在毀滅性 Check Point Gateway 攻擊中遭利用》最早發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Check Point gateways hacked via PHP2Shell to deploy VMware ESXi wiper
items.summary: Vulnerable Check Point Security Gateway instances have been targeted in PHP2Shell attacks that deployed data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts. [...]
items.title_zh: Check Point 閘道遭經由 PHP2Shell 入侵以部署 VMware ESXi 資料抹除軟體
items.summary_zh: 存在漏洞的 Check Point Security Gateway 執行個體已成為 PHP2Shell 攻擊的目標，攻擊者在 VMware ESXi 主機上部署了資料抹除惡意軟體。[...]

items.title: SilentAir Hackers Intercept Calls, SMS From Inside Mobile Networks
items.summary: Enea says SilentAir hijacked mobile network nodes to intercept calls and messages, with Taiwanese subscribers the primary targets. The post SilentAir Hackers Intercept Calls, SMS From Inside Mobile Networks appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: SilentAir 黑客從行動網路內部劫持通話與簡訊
items.summary_zh: Enea 表示，SilentAir 劫持了行動網路節點以攔截通話和訊息，其中臺灣用戶是主要的目標。《SilentAir Hackers Intercept Calls, SMS From Inside Mobile Networks》首先出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.title: New worm-like 'SCKit' malware targets MSPs in ScreenConnect attacks
items.summary: A new worm-like malware toolkit named SCKit was deployed in the recent ScreenConnect attacks targeting managed service providers (MSPs), designed to spread from infected customer devices to MSP technicians' computers and compromise additional managed networks. [...]
items.title_zh: 新型類蠕蟲「SCKit」惡意軟體在 ScreenConnect 攻擊中針對 MSP
items.summary_zh: 近期針對託管服務提供者 (MSP) 的 ScreenConnect 攻擊中，部署了一套名為 SCKit 的新型類蠕蟲惡意軟體工具包，旨在從受感染的客戶裝置傳播至 MSP 技術人員的電腦，並入侵其他託管網路。[...]

items.title: Hackers compromise 4,800 GitHub accounts to steal cloud credentials
items.summary: A new campaign dubbed 'wfx-loot' has unfolded on GitHub where threat actors used 4,837 compromised accounts to probe 61,764 repositories, open pull requests, and push secrets-stealing malware. [...]
items.title_zh: 黑客入侵 4,800 個 GitHub 帳號以竊取雲端憑證
items.summary_zh: GitHub 上展開了一項名為「wfx-loot」的新活動，威脅脅迫者利用 4,837 個被妥協的帳號來探測 61,764 個儲存庫、發起 Pull Request 並推送用於竊取機密的惡意軟體。[...]
